flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/parameter (Parameter, ParameterController), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsChangeOfProcessing/ChangeOfProcessingService. ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/helpers/ToppanUploadHelper, framework/schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler, agencies/lta/download/helpers/LtaProcessingStageManager, cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminui pages/System (ParameterList, ParameterForm), utils/validation/System/ValidParameter.ts, App.tsx. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code
note: The story asks that an officer can set the number of days at each stage per notice type. The days per stage are stored in ocms_parameter (parameter_id STAGEDAYS, code = stage), can be edited by the officer on System > Parameter, and are read when the stage changes. That is the core of the story and it exists. Three things are missing. (1) Not per notice type: the parameter key is only parameter_id + code, there is no notice type column. (2) The value is not validated as a number in the UI or the API (only required; ParameterController only whitelists fields and HTML-escapes); a wrong or empty value makes Toppan silently use the enum number (14 days), while the LTA cron skips the update and only writes an error log. (3) next_processing_date is stored on the notice when it enters the stage, so a STAGEDAYS change only applies to notices entering the stage afterwards and does not recompute notices already waiting. (4) Manual stage change through portal CPS and PLUS does not use STAGEDAYS: both paths use manual mode so next_processing_date = current time (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1035, 1498, 1093-1118); the branch that reads STAGEDAYS (1129-1146) is never called. Toppan day-end path: the executeJob() call is commented out so it runs manually only. The other letter parameters (POS, PDD) and ENOTEDAYS/ENA for electronic reminders are also stored in ocms_parameter but are outside the steps of this story. Real parameter values on the server: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially. Configuring the days per stage through the Parameter page exists and is used, but not per notice type and without number validation. Ask URA/the team to confirm whether one value per stage (not per notice type) is accepted

steps.step: The days of each stage are stored as parameter STAGEDAYS and the officer can change them on the Parameter page
steps.detail: The System > Parameter page (App.tsx:375-396) lists all ocms_parameter rows (POST /parameterlist, ParameterController.java:81-88) and allows editing the description and value fields through POST /parameterpatch/{id1}/{id2} (ParameterController.java:90-118; form ParameterForm.tsx:154-175). The STAGEDAYS row (Parameter ID STAGEDAYS, Code = stage) is read by the Toppan cron and the LTA cron when a notice enters the stage (see the two steps below). Function OCMS_SYSTEM_PARAMETER is mapped in api-authorization.properties:166-167; which roles hold it: cannot verify from repo. Note: the value is only required, with no number or range check (ValidParameter.ts:44-46). The server only whitelists fields and HTML-escapes (ParameterController.java:90-92, OCMS-SR-2026-039). No seed of the initial values was found in the repo.

steps.step: The number of days can differ for each notice type
steps.detail: The ocms_parameter key is only parameter_id + code (Parameter.java:28-38); there is no notice type column. STAGEDAYS is always read as getParameterValue("STAGEDAYS", stage) without a notice type, both in Toppan (ToppanUploadHelper.java:157-163) and in the LTA cron (LtaProcessingStageManager.java:387-388). One value applies to all notice types.

steps.step: The Toppan day-end cron computes the next processing date from the configured days of the stage
steps.detail: resolveStageContext reads STAGEDAYS per stage (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1825-1829; getStageDurationDays at 157-170) and next_processing_date = processing date + days (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1368-1370). If the parameter is missing or badly formatted it silently falls back to the number in the ToppanStage enum (14 days for RD1..DN2, 0 for DR3; ToppanStage.java:19-24) with a warning. But the executeJob() call in the day-end scheduler is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118), so this path only runs through the manual trigger; per the addendum rule this step is at most Sebagian. Real server value: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The LTA cron that moves a notice into stage ENA uses the configured ENA days
steps.detail: When moving a notice from ROV to ENA, LtaProcessingStageManager reads ocms_parameter STAGEDAYS/ENA (LtaProcessingStageManager.java:383-410) and sets next_processing_date = now + days (LtaProcessingStageManager.java:417). If the parameter is missing, empty or non-numeric the update is aborted with an error log, with no default (LtaProcessingStageManager.java:392-411); this differs from Toppan, which falls back to the enum number of days. The LTA download cron is enabled=true in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:148-149; real server value: cannot verify from repo). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-052 (ENA vs RD1 stage for diplomat notices, Closed) does not change how the days are read.
